A: Dieter 'Hilprant', district judge in the County of Hirschberg
S: District Court Hirschberg (District of Eichstätt)
E: Abbess Agnes of Leonrod and the community of Seligenporten Monastery
Subject: Court letter with confirmation of the individually listed properties located in the County of Hirschberg as free allodial property of Seligenporten Monastery:
the church at Seligenporten, the village of 'Kutenhausen' (Kittenhausen, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.),
the village of 'Pabsenspach' (Pavelsbach, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.),
the 'Oberdorff' (upper village in Pavelsbach) and 'Eysperch' (Asbach, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.),
Birkenlach (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.), at Möning (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the 'Telczenhoff',
the farm occupied by the Pöllinger, the farm occupied by Hermann 'Dyetrer', the farm occupied by the 'Dürmair',
the farm occupied by the 'Ländrer', two farmsteads there and the 'Rewthöffe' (Richthof, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.),
on which the 'Strobl' sits, and the farm occupied by the 'Vederlein'; at Aßlschwang (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.)
the property occupied by Hermann 'Plensär', the farm occupied by the 'Vesman', and the property occupied by the 'Nadlär';
at Rohr (District of Roth) the property occupied by the 'Gesmötz'; at 'Ebenrewt' (Ebenried, District of Roth)
the property occupied by the 'Plikendrat', and the property there occupied by the 'Kutzhawpt';
at Mörsdorf (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the 'Stainhoff', the property occupied by the 'Widenman',
the property occupied by the 'Smidel', the property occupied by the son of the 'Plensärs', and the property
occupied by the 'Vnger'; at 'Jostorff' (Jahrsdorf, District of Roth) the property occupied by the 'Grübel';
the property at 'Wäczleinshoff' (Waizenhofen, District of Roth, or demolished near Jahrsdorf), on which the
'Hutzelmair' sits; at Pyras (District of Roth) the property occupied by the 'Kornmair'; at Eysölden (District of Roth)
the property occupied by the 'Hübner', and the property occupied by Ottel 'Mair'; at 'Stetn' (Stetten, District of Roth)
the property occupied by the 'Goglär'; at Thalmässing (District of Roth) the property occupied by the 'Widenman',
and the upper church and tithe there; at Alfershausen (District of Roth) the church, tithe, widow's portion on which
the 'Widman' sits and the property occupied by the 'Spillär'; at Stetten (District of Roth) the fields in the field
and two meadow plots that the 'Lundelmair' had from the monastery, and the property occupied by Ullein 'Mair';
at Steinbach (District of Nürnberger Land) the 'Loterhof', on which the 'Wolfflein' sits, and three properties
on which the 'Matzner', the 'Vorster' and the 'Telling' sit; at Heuberg (District of Roth) the church, tithe
and three properties on which the 'Pütel', his brother-in-law and the 'Gräter' sit; at 'Eysprehtzstorf' (Eismannsdorf,
District of Roth) the property occupied by the 'Kurcz'; at 'Harlach' (Harrlach, District of Roth) the property on which
the 'Vogelsängerin' sits; at 'Hartzhoff' (Harrhof, District of Roth) the property on which the 'Rül' and the 'Koller' sit;
at 'Hännpach' (Oberhembach, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.?) the property on which the 'Hümel' and the 'Igelfritz' sit;
at 'Kesselpach' (Köstlbach, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the five properties on which the 'Prenner', the 'Mair',
Markel 'Mair', the 'Räwschel' and the 'Hannhödel' sit; at Pölling (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the parish, tithe
and eight properties on which Fritz 'Hainholt', the 'Widenman', the 'Snabel', the 'Angrär', the 'Harbsleben',
the 'Koblär', the 'Selfliez' and the 'Gütlär' sit; at Holzheim (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the property occupied
by Markel 'Mair', and the farmsteads and tithes; at Tyrolsberg (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the four properties on which
the 'Rascher', the 'Zeidlär' and the two 'Lurtzer' sit, and the tithe; at Winnberg (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) three
properties on which the 'Gäwtner', the 'Herdlär' and the 'Albrecht' sit; at Tauernfeld (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.)
the property occupied by the 'Fuzsel'; at Leutenbach (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) the property occupied by the 'Smidel';
at 'Yschoffen' (Ischhofen, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.), where the 'Aichelperger' sits, the property at Mittersthal
(District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) on which the 'Velser' sits; the six properties at Kleinalfalterbach (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.)
on which the 'Meinerstorfer', the 'Vischer', the son of 'Wernhers', Ullein 'Mair', the 'Polster' and the 'Lantzhhuter' sit;
at 'Pahtzhawsen' (Batzhausen, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) three properties on which the 'Krappenhofer', the 'Strobel'
and the 'Hotter' sit; at 'Pircheich' (Pirkach, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) three properties on which Götzen's son,
the 'Veter' and the 'Kagrär' sit; the property at 'Hawsn' (Hausen, District of Roth) occupied by the 'Grufenmair';
the property at Ittelhofen (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) that the 'Stahel' builds; the property at 'Keffenhul' (Kevenhüll,
District of Eichstätt) that the 'Kastner' builds; the property at 'Heinspergch' on which the 'Chüttelmair' sits;
two properties with associated farmsteads at Pfraundorf (District of Eichstätt) on which the 'Kolman', the 'Halpmair'
and the 'Sneider' sit; the farm at 'Kunerstorf' (Körnersdorf, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Erlacher';
the mill at 'Almerstorf' (Ellmannsdorf, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.); the property at Frettenshofen (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.)
occupied by the 'Zeitzlär'; the property at 'Weipperstorf' (Wappersdorf, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Mair';
the property at Wangen (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by Ulrich; the property at 'Winnerzhofen' (Winterzhofen,
District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Kekel'; the property at 'Hernsperg' (Herrnsberg, District of Roth) occupied
by the 'Stokel'; the property at 'Riblingen' (Rübling, District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Roslein';
the property at 'Käwssingen' (Kaising, District of Roth) occupied by the 'Hindermair'; the property at Landerzhofen
(District of Roth) occupied by the 'Schaffer'; the five properties at Weidenwang (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) on which
the 'Mair', the 'Ressel', the 'Streb', the 'Huter' and the son of 'Perchtolds' sit; the castle mound at Hohenweidenwang;
the property at [Great-]Berghausen (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Wernher'; the property at Kleinberghausen
(District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Schrampawmer'; the four properties at 'Obernrewt' (Obernricht, District of
Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) on which the 'Chastner', Fritz 'Sighart', the 'May' and the 'Pesolt' sit; the six properties at Forchheim
(District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) on which 'Mulherman', the 'Sneider', the 'Krawtzer', the 'Lewhtzner', the 'Hullär' and the
'Vederlein' sit; the property at Ohausen (District of Neumarkt i.d.OPf.) occupied by the 'Sneyder'; the property at 'Kawrhoff'

entries.abstract: Dieter Hilprant, judge in the County of Hirschberg, confirmed the listed properties as the free property of Seligenporten Monastery. The record names extensive estates, churches, tithes, farms, and other holdings across the region. It appoints a group of secular and ecclesiastical authorities, including Konrad von Rosenberg, Vicar of Amberg, as protectors of the monastery's possessions.
